  assign io_value = csr_register;

endmodule

module TopModule (
    input  in,
    input  [3:0] state,
    output reg [3:0] next_state,
    output reg out
);

    // State transition logic
    always @(*) begin
        case (state)
            4'b0001: begin
                if (in == 1'b0) next_state = 4'b0001; // A
                else next_state = 4'b0010; // B
            end
            4'b0010: begin
                if (in == 1'b0) next_state = 4'b0100; // C
                else next_state = 4'b0010; // B
            end
            4'b0100: begin
                if (in == 1'b0) next_state = 4'b0001; // A
                else next_state = 4'b1000; // D
            end
            4'b1000: begin
                if (in == 1'b0) next_state = 4'b0100; // C
                else next_state = 4'b0010; // B
            end
            default: next_state = 4'b0001; // Default to state A
        endcase
    end

    // Output logic
    always @(*) begin
        case (state)
            4'b0001: out = 1'b0;
            4'b0010: out = 1'b0;
            4'b0100: out = 1'b0;
            4'b1000: out = 1'b1;
            default: out = 1'b0; // Default to output 0
        endcase
    end

endmodule

module TopModule (
    input  clk,
    input  load,
    input  [9:0] data,  // 10-bit data input
    output reg tc      // Terminal count output
);

    // Internal counter
    reg [9:0] counter;

    // D flip-flop for the terminal count
    always @(posedge clk) begin
        if (load) begin
            counter <= data;  // Load the counter with the input data
            tc <= 0;          // Reset the terminal count
        end else begin
            if (counter > 0) begin
                counter <= counter - 1;  // Decrement the counter
                tc <= 0;              // Reset the terminal count
            end else begin
                tc <= 1;              // Assert terminal count when counter reaches 0
            end
        end
    end

endmodule
